title: Turn important reference unknowns into targeted, auditable research
problem: An occluded view, missing dimension, or conflicting variant can silently become invented geometry when the agent gathers images broadly or treats every search result as equally authoritative.

exclusions: deferred high-impact uncertainty without a human decision

preconditions: the target and intended variant are explicitly identified
the uncertainty names a property that could affect modeling or evaluation
the current evidence does not already resolve the question
required_observations: why the current set cannot answer the question
the modeling impact if the answer is wrong
source identity and variant for every inspected candidate
the exact claim each accepted source is allowed to support
action_policy: Turn the unknown into one property-scoped question and one or more exact search queries.
Record inspected candidates even when rejected, including provenance, observed variant, and rejection reason.
Link accepted candidates to factual ReferenceItem records; never let an accepted conclusion float free of its source.
Keep high-impact questions open until accepted evidence or a human decision resolves them.
A lower-impact question may be deferred only with a concrete reversible modeling constraint and an evaluation exclusion.
Return to targeted research when modeling reveals a new important uncertainty.
expected_effects: clear separation between same-variant evidence and attractive but irrelevant results
a planner-visible stop condition when important evidence is still missing
cheap revision of explicitly deferred low-impact geometry
failure_predicates: a high-impact question remains open while blockout begins
an accepted candidate does not link to a reference item
a deferred question has no modeling constraint
a different variant silently authorizes target geometry
search quantity is reported as success without property coverage
recovery: reject or narrow the unsupported candidate
remove geometry that relied on the unsupported claim or keep it isolated and revisable

sources.description: Seven user-supplied reference-workflow videos converged on purpose-scoped sources, schema-visible missing evidence, and task-specific fidelity; all raw items remain separately bounded.
The artist assigns different secondary sources to specific facial, hair, and color properties rather than letting one source control the whole design.
The demonstrated visual wiki keeps stable evidence fields and direct source clips adjacent to claims.

runtime_usage.result: Resolved the official overall envelope, retained five rejected candidates, and bounded underside/revision uncertainty without authorizing modeling.

version_scope: Reference policy is Blender-version independent; strict stage-gate behavior verified with Blender 5.2 LTS.
status_note: Runtime validated for question-driven reference gating on one real product board. It is not transfer validated and has not yet demonstrated improved model fidelity in the pending equal-budget comparison.
